q20349.en: The sign shown is placed at the end of the pedestrian path.

explain.short: The red bar across the walking person means the pedestrian path ends here.
explain.rule: Blue sign + red bar = end of an obligation. Here the path reserved for pedestrians ends.
explain.trap: 'fine del percorso pedonale' (end of the pedestrian path) is exactly what the red bar means.

sceneParams.caption: End of the path reserved for pedestrians

q20350.en: The sign shown is placed at the end of the pedestrian avenue.

explain.short: A 'viale pedonale' (pedestrian avenue) is a path reserved for pedestrians; the red bar says it ends here.
explain.rule: Blue sign + red bar = end of an obligation. Here the path reserved for pedestrians ends.
explain.trap: 'viale pedonale' is just another name for the pedestrian path: the answer does not change.

sceneParams.caption: End of the pedestrian path (viale pedonale)

q20351.en: The sign shown indicates that from there on pedestrians no longer walk on a reserved path.

explain.short: After the end sign the reserved pedestrian path is over, so pedestrians walk on the normal pavement or road.
explain.rule: Blue sign + red bar = end of an obligation. Here the path reserved for pedestrians ends.
explain.trap: 'non circolano più su un percorso riservato' (no longer on a reserved path) is the meaning of 'end of path'.

sceneParams.caption: From here pedestrians have no reserved path

q20352.en: The sign shown warns of a pedestrian crossing.

explain.short: This is the end of a pedestrian path, not a warning. A pedestrian crossing warning is a red triangle.
explain.rule: Blue sign + red bar = end of an obligation. Here the path reserved for pedestrians ends.
explain.trap: 'preannuncia un attraversamento pedonale' (warns of a crossing) is wrong: blue round signs do not warn of danger.

sceneParams.caption: Not a crossing: the pedestrian path ends here

q20353.en: The sign shown warns of a no-entry for pedestrians.

explain.short: The sign does not ban pedestrians: it only says their reserved path ends. A ban would be a red-bordered sign.
explain.rule: Blue sign + red bar = end of an obligation. Here the path reserved for pedestrians ends.
explain.trap: 'divieto di transito per i pedoni' (no entry for pedestrians) is wrong: blue + red bar means END, not ban.

sceneParams.caption: Not a ban: only the pedestrian path ends

q20354.en: The sign shown forbids pedestrians to cross the road.

explain.short: The sign forbids nothing. It only says the path reserved for pedestrians ends here.
explain.rule: Blue sign + red bar = end of an obligation. Here the path reserved for pedestrians ends.
explain.trap: 'vieta ai pedoni di attraversare' (forbids pedestrians to cross) is wrong: an end sign bans nothing.

sceneParams.caption: No ban: the pedestrian path just ends

q20355.en: The sign shown warns of the end of an area closed to pedestrians.

explain.short: It is the opposite: it is the end of a path reserved FOR pedestrians, not of an area closed to them.
explain.rule: Blue sign + red bar = end of an obligation. Here the path reserved for pedestrians ends.
explain.trap: 'area vietata ai pedoni' (area closed to pedestrians) is wrong: the path was reserved to pedestrians.

sceneParams.caption: End of a path FOR pedestrians, not against them

q20356.en: The sign shown is placed at a path closed to cars and motorcycles.

explain.short: The cycle path is reserved for bicycles only, so cars and motorcycles may not use it.
explain.rule: A blue round sign with a bicycle = a path ONLY for bicycles. No cars, motorcycles or mopeds.
explain.trap: 'vietato alle autovetture e ai motocicli' (closed to cars and motorcycles) is right: only bicycles may use it.

sceneParams.caption: Bicycles only: no cars, no motorcycles

q20357.en: The sign shown is placed at a lane reserved for bicycles.

explain.short: The white bicycle on blue marks a cycle path or cycle lane: reserved for bicycles.
explain.rule: A blue round sign with a bicycle = a path ONLY for bicycles. No cars, motorcycles or mopeds.
explain.trap: 'corsia riservata alle biciclette' (lane reserved for bicycles) is right: corsia or pista, it is for bikes only.

sceneParams.caption: Lane reserved for bicycles

q20358.en: The sign shown is placed at a path reserved for bicycles.

explain.short: This is the cycle path sign: the path is reserved for bicycles.
explain.rule: A blue round sign with a bicycle = a path ONLY for bicycles. No cars, motorcycles or mopeds.
explain.trap: 'percorso riservato alle biciclette' (path reserved for bicycles) is the exact meaning.

sceneParams.caption: Path reserved for bicycles

q20360.en: The sign shown is placed at a cycle crossing controlled by traffic lights.

explain.short: The sign marks a cycle path. It says nothing about a crossing or traffic lights.
explain.rule: A blue round sign with a bicycle = a path ONLY for bicycles. No cars, motorcycles or mopeds.
explain.trap: 'attraversamento ciclabile regolato da semaforo' (bike crossing with lights) is wrong: no lights on this sign.

sceneParams.caption: A cycle path, not a crossing with lights

q20361.en: The sign shown forbids bicycles to pass.

explain.short: It is the opposite: the blue sign reserves the path FOR bicycles. A ban on bicycles is a red-bordered sign.
explain.rule: A blue round sign with a bicycle = a path ONLY for bicycles. No cars, motorcycles or mopeds.
explain.trap: 'vieta il transito alle biciclette' (forbids bicycles) is wrong: blue = obligation, red border = ban.

sceneParams.caption: Blue = path FOR bicycles, not a ban

q20362.en: The sign shown is placed at a path for pedestrians and bicycles.

explain.short: The sign shows only a bicycle: the path is for bicycles only, not for pedestrians.
explain.rule: A blue round sign with a bicycle = a path ONLY for bicycles. No cars, motorcycles or mopeds.
explain.trap: 'per pedoni e biciclette' (for pedestrians and bicycles) is wrong: there is no pedestrian on the sign.

sceneParams.caption: Only a bicycle: no pedestrians on this path

q20363.en: The sign shown is placed at a path reserved for bicycles and mopeds.

explain.short: Mopeds (ciclomotori) have an engine: they may not use a cycle path. It is for bicycles only.
explain.rule: A blue round sign with a bicycle = a path ONLY for bicycles. No cars, motorcycles or mopeds.
explain.trap: 'e ai ciclomotori' (and mopeds) is the trap: mopeds are motor vehicles, not bicycles.

sceneParams.caption: Bicycles only: mopeds may not enter

q20364.en: The sign shown is placed at a path open to pedestrians and bicycles.

explain.short: Only a bicycle is drawn: the path is for bicycles, not for pedestrians.
explain.rule: A blue round sign with a bicycle = a path ONLY for bicycles. No cars, motorcycles or mopeds.
explain.trap: 'transito di pedoni e di biciclette' is wrong: the shared path sign also shows a pedestrian.

sceneParams.caption: Only bicycles: pedestrians are not included

q20365.en: The sign shown is placed at an area closed to bicycles.

explain.short: It is the opposite: the path is reserved FOR bicycles. A ban on bicycles has a red border.
explain.rule: A blue round sign with a bicycle = a path ONLY for bicycles. No cars, motorcycles or mopeds.
explain.trap: 'area vietata al transito delle biciclette' (closed to bicycles) is wrong: blue = reserved for them.

sceneParams.caption: Reserved FOR bicycles, not closed to them

q20366.en: The sign shown is placed at the end of the cycle path.

explain.short: The red bar across the bicycle means the cycle path ends here.
explain.rule: Red bar on a blue sign = the obligation ends. The path only for bicycles ends here.
explain.trap: 'fine della pista ciclabile' (end of the cycle path) is exactly what the red bar means.

sceneParams.caption: End of the cycle path

q20367.en: The sign shown is placed at the end of a route that can be used only by bicycles.

explain.short: A cycle path is a route only for bicycles; the red bar says it ends here.
explain.rule: Red bar on a blue sign = the obligation ends. The path only for bicycles ends here.
explain.trap: 'percorribile solo con biciclette' (only by bicycles) describes the cycle path, and 'fine' says it ends.

sceneParams.caption: End of the route only for bicycles

q20368.en: The sign shown is placed at the end of a lane reserved for cyclists.

explain.short: The cycle lane is reserved for cyclists; the red bar says it ends here.
explain.rule: Red bar on a blue sign = the obligation ends. The path only for bicycles ends here.
explain.trap: 'corsia riservata ai ciclisti' (lane for cyclists) is another way to say cycle path.

sceneParams.caption: End of the lane reserved for cyclists

q20369.en: The sign shown is placed at the end of a path reserved for bicycles.

explain.short: The red bar across the bicycle means the path reserved for bicycles ends.
explain.rule: Red bar on a blue sign = the obligation ends. The path only for bicycles ends here.
explain.trap: 'fine di una pista riservata alle biciclette' is the exact meaning of this sign.

sceneParams.caption: End of the path reserved for bicycles

q20370.en: The sign shown indicates no parking for bicycles.

explain.short: The sign is about the end of a cycle path, not about parking.
explain.rule: Red bar on a blue sign = the obligation ends. The path only for bicycles ends here.
explain.trap: 'divieto di sosta' (no parking) is wrong: the red bar on a blue sign means END, not a ban.

sceneParams.caption: Not a parking ban: the cycle path ends

q20371.en: The sign shown forbids bicycles and mopeds to pass.

explain.short: An end sign bans nothing: the cycle path ends and cyclists continue on the normal road.
explain.rule: Red bar on a blue sign = the obligation ends. The path only for bicycles ends here.
explain.trap: 'vieta il transito' (forbids passage) is wrong: blue + red bar = end of an obligation, not a ban.

sceneParams.caption: No ban: only the cycle path ends

q20372.en: The sign shown is placed at the end of the pedestrian and cycle path.

explain.short: Only a bicycle is drawn: it is the end of the cycle path only, not of a shared path with pedestrians.
explain.rule: Red bar on a blue sign = the obligation ends. The path only for bicycles ends here.
explain.trap: 'percorso pedonale e ciclabile' is wrong: that end sign also shows a pedestrian.

sceneParams.caption: Only the cycle path ends: no pedestrian drawn

q20373.en: The sign shown warns that cyclists and pedestrians may no longer pass.

explain.short: Nothing is forbidden: only the cycle path ends. Cyclists go on along the normal road.
explain.rule: Red bar on a blue sign = the obligation ends. The path only for bicycles ends here.
explain.trap: 'non è più consentito il transito' (no longer allowed) is wrong: the end sign forbids nothing.

sceneParams.caption: Nothing forbidden: the cycle path just ends

q20374.en: The sign shown is placed at the start of an area closed to bicycles.

explain.short: It is the END of a path reserved for bicycles, not the start of an area closed to them.
explain.rule: Red bar on a blue sign = the obligation ends. The path only for bicycles ends here.
explain.trap: 'all'inizio di un'area vietata' (start of a closed area) is wrong twice: it is an end, and nothing is banned.

sceneParams.caption: End of a path FOR bicycles, not a ban

q20375.en: The sign shown is placed at the start of a cycle path next to the pavement.

explain.short: The vertical line splits the sign: a cycle path runs next to a path for pedestrians, like the pavement.
explain.rule: Vertical line = two SEPARATE paths side by side: pedestrians on one, bicycles on the other.
explain.trap: 'pista ciclabile accanto al marciapiede' (cycle path next to the pavement) is right: two separate parts.

sceneParams.caption: Cycle path next to the pedestrian part

q20376.en: The sign shown is placed at the start of a lane reserved for bicycles next to a pedestrian path.

explain.short: One side is for bicycles, the other side for pedestrians: two paths side by side, separated.
explain.rule: Vertical line = two SEPARATE paths side by side: pedestrians on one, bicycles on the other.
explain.trap: 'accanto ad un percorso pedonale' (next to a pedestrian path) is right: the line shows they are separate.

sceneParams.caption: Bike lane beside a pedestrian path

q20377.en: The sign shown is placed at the start of a path reserved for bicycles, alongside a pedestrian avenue.

explain.short: The bicycle side is the cycle path; the pedestrian side is the pedestrian avenue next to it.
explain.rule: Vertical line = two SEPARATE paths side by side: pedestrians on one, bicycles on the other.
explain.trap: 'affiancata da un viale pedonale' (alongside a pedestrian avenue) is right: separate paths side by side.

sceneParams.caption: Cycle path alongside a pedestrian path

q20378.en: The sign shown is placed at the start of a cycle path next to a pedestrian path.

explain.short: The vertical line means two separate paths: a cycle path and a pedestrian path next to each other.
explain.rule: Vertical line = two SEPARATE paths side by side: pedestrians on one, bicycles on the other.
explain.trap: 'percorso ciclabile accanto ad un percorso pedonale' is the exact meaning of this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Cycle path beside a pedestrian path

q20379.en: The sign shown does not allow motor vehicles to circulate.

explain.short: The paths are reserved for pedestrians and bicycles, so motor vehicles may not use them.
explain.rule: Vertical line = two SEPARATE paths side by side: pedestrians on one, bicycles on the other.
explain.trap: 'non consente ... veicoli a motore' (no motor vehicles) is right: only pedestrians and bicycles.

sceneParams.caption: Only pedestrians and bikes: no motor vehicles

q20380.en: The sign shown is placed at a single path for pedestrians and cyclists.

explain.short: The vertical line means two SEPARATE paths, not one shared path.
explain.rule: Vertical line = two SEPARATE paths side by side: pedestrians on one, bicycles on the other.
explain.trap: 'percorso unico' (single path) is wrong: the shared-path sign has the symbols one above the other.

sceneParams.caption: Two separate paths, not one shared path

q20381.en: The sign shown is placed at a mixed avenue, reserved both for pedestrians and for cyclists.

explain.short: The vertical line separates pedestrians from bicycles: the paths are separate, not mixed.
explain.rule: Vertical line = two SEPARATE paths side by side: pedestrians on one, bicycles on the other.
explain.trap: 'viale misto' (mixed avenue) is wrong: here each group has its own side.

sceneParams.caption: Separate sides, not a mixed path

q20382.en: The sign shown is placed at the end of the lanes reserved for pedestrians and bicycles.

explain.short: There is no red bar: this sign marks the START of the paths, not their end.
explain.rule: Vertical line = two SEPARATE paths side by side: pedestrians on one, bicycles on the other.
explain.trap: 'della fine' (of the end) is wrong: an end sign would have a red diagonal bar.

sceneParams.caption: No red bar: the paths START here

q20383.en: The sign shown warns of the obligation to push the bicycle by hand.

explain.short: Bicycles may ride on their own side. Nothing tells cyclists to get off and push.
explain.rule: Vertical line = two SEPARATE paths side by side: pedestrians on one, bicycles on the other.
explain.trap: 'condurre a mano la bicicletta' (push the bicycle by hand) is wrong: cyclists ride on the cycle side.

sceneParams.caption: Cyclists ride on their side: no pushing

q20384.en: The sign shown warns of the obligation to park the bicycle and continue on foot.

explain.short: There is a path for bicycles: cyclists continue riding, they do not have to park.
explain.rule: Vertical line = two SEPARATE paths side by side: pedestrians on one, bicycles on the other.
explain.trap: 'parcheggiare la bicicletta e proseguire a piedi' is wrong: the cycle side is open to bikes.

sceneParams.caption: Bicycles continue on their own path

q20385.en: The sign shown is placed at a single path for pedestrians and cyclists.

explain.short: Pedestrian above bicycle with no dividing line = one path shared by pedestrians and cyclists.
explain.rule: Symbols one above the other, no line = ONE path shared by pedestrians and cyclists.
explain.trap: 'percorso unico' (single path) is right: no line means they share the same path.

sceneParams.caption: One shared path for pedestrians and cyclists

q20386.en: The sign shown is placed at a mixed avenue, reserved both for pedestrians and for cyclists.

explain.short: The symbols are one above the other: pedestrians and cyclists use the same (mixed) path.
explain.rule: Symbols one above the other, no line = ONE path shared by pedestrians and cyclists.
explain.trap: 'viale misto' (mixed avenue) is right: it is shared, not split.

sceneParams.caption: A mixed path for pedestrians and cyclists

q20387.en: The sign shown is placed at a route reserved only for pedestrians and cyclists.

explain.short: Only pedestrians and cyclists may use this path; all motor vehicles are excluded.
explain.rule: Symbols one above the other, no line = ONE path shared by pedestrians and cyclists.
explain.trap: 'riservato solo' (reserved only) is right: only the two users drawn on the sign.

sceneParams.caption: Only pedestrians and cyclists may use it

q20388.en: The sign shown does not allow motor vehicles to circulate.

explain.short: The path is only for pedestrians and cyclists, so motor vehicles may not use it.
explain.rule: Symbols one above the other, no line = ONE path shared by pedestrians and cyclists.
explain.trap: 'non consente ... veicoli a motore' (no motor vehicles) is right: only people on foot and bikes.

sceneParams.caption: No motor vehicles on this path

q20389.en: The sign shown is placed at a cycle path beside the pavement.

explain.short: There is no dividing line: it is one shared path, not a cycle path next to a pavement.
explain.rule: Symbols one above the other, no line = ONE path shared by pedestrians and cyclists.
explain.trap: 'pista ciclabile a fianco del marciapiede' is wrong: that is the sign with a vertical line.

sceneParams.caption: One shared path, not two side by side

q20390.en: The sign shown is placed at a cycle path beside a path reserved for pedestrians.

explain.short: The symbols are not separated by a line: it is one shared path, not two paths side by side.
explain.rule: Symbols one above the other, no line = ONE path shared by pedestrians and cyclists.
explain.trap: 'a fianco di un percorso riservato ai pedoni' is wrong: separate paths have a vertical line.

sceneParams.caption: Shared path: no separate pedestrian path

q20391.en: The sign shown is placed at a pedestrian area next to a path for cyclists.

explain.short: It is one shared path for both, not a pedestrian area plus a separate cycle path.
explain.rule: Symbols one above the other, no line = ONE path shared by pedestrians and cyclists.
explain.trap: 'area pedonale accanto ad un percorso per ciclisti' is wrong: nothing is separated on this sign.

sceneParams.caption: One path for both, not two areas

q20392.en: The sign shown is placed at a pedestrian path next to a bicycle path, separated by a traffic island.

explain.short: Nothing is separated: pedestrians and cyclists share one path.
explain.rule: Symbols one above the other, no line = ONE path shared by pedestrians and cyclists.
explain.trap: 'separati da spartitraffico' (separated by a traffic island) is wrong: the paths are not separate.

sceneParams.caption: Shared path: nothing separates them

q20393.en: The sign shown is placed at an area where bicycles may go only if pushed by hand.

explain.short: Cyclists may ride on this shared path; they do not have to get off and push.
explain.rule: Symbols one above the other, no line = ONE path shared by pedestrians and cyclists.
explain.trap: 'soltanto se condotte a mano' (only if pushed by hand) is wrong: bikes may be ridden here.

sceneParams.caption: Bicycles may be ridden on this path

q20394.en: The sign shown is placed at the end of the cycle path next to the pavement.

explain.short: Split sign with a red bar: the cycle path and the pedestrian part next to it end here.
explain.rule: Red bar = END of the two side-by-side paths (pedestrian path and cycle path).
explain.trap: 'fine della pista ciclabile accanto al marciapiede' is right: the red bar means end.

sceneParams.caption: End of the cycle path beside the pavement

q20395.en: The sign shown is placed at the end of the cycle path next to a path reserved for pedestrians.

explain.short: The red bar ends both paths: the cycle path and the pedestrian path beside it.
explain.rule: Red bar = END of the two side-by-side paths (pedestrian path and cycle path).
explain.trap: 'fine della pista ciclabile accanto ad un percorso riservato ai pedoni' matches the split sign with a bar.

sceneParams.caption: End of cycle path beside the pedestrian path

q20396.en: The sign shown is placed at the end of the pedestrian path beside the cycle path.

explain.short: The bar ends both sides: the pedestrian path and the cycle path next to it.
explain.rule: Red bar = END of the two side-by-side paths (pedestrian path and cycle path).
explain.trap: 'fine del percorso pedonale a fianco della pista ciclabile' is right: same sign, seen from the pedestrian side.

sceneParams.caption: End of pedestrian path beside the cycle path

q20397.en: The sign shown is placed at the end of the pedestrian path next to a cycle path.

explain.short: The red bar across the split sign ends the pedestrian path and the cycle path next to it.
explain.rule: Red bar = END of the two side-by-side paths (pedestrian path and cycle path).
explain.trap: 'fine del percorso pedonale accanto ad un percorso ciclabile' is right: the bar means end.

sceneParams.caption: End of pedestrian and cycle paths side by side

q20398.en: The sign shown forbids all two-wheeled vehicles to pass.

explain.short: An end sign bans nothing: it only says the pedestrian and cycle paths end.
explain.rule: Red bar = END of the two side-by-side paths (pedestrian path and cycle path).
explain.trap: 'vieta il transito' (forbids passage) is wrong: a blue sign with a red bar is an END, not a ban.

sceneParams.caption: No ban: the two paths just end

q20399.en: The sign shown forbids bicycles pushed by hand to pass.

explain.short: Nothing is forbidden: the sign only marks the end of the pedestrian and cycle paths.
explain.rule: Red bar = END of the two side-by-side paths (pedestrian path and cycle path).
explain.trap: 'vieta il transito di biciclette condotte a mano' is wrong: an end sign does not ban anyone.

sceneParams.caption: No ban: only the end of the paths

q20400.en: The sign shown is placed at a path reserved on some days for pedestrians and on others for bicycles.

explain.short: The two symbols are side by side because the paths are side by side, not because of different days.
explain.rule: Red bar = END of the two side-by-side paths (pedestrian path and cycle path).
explain.trap: 'in alcuni giorni ... in altri' (some days ... other days) is wrong: no days are shown, and it is an end sign.

sceneParams.caption: Side by side paths end, nothing about days

q20401.en: The sign shown forbids pedestrians to enter at night.

explain.short: There is no time and no ban: it is just the end of the pedestrian and cycle paths.
explain.rule: Red bar = END of the two side-by-side paths (pedestrian path and cycle path).
explain.trap: 'nelle ore notturne' (at night) is wrong: nothing on the sign speaks of hours or bans.

sceneParams.caption: No night ban: the paths just end

q20402.en: The sign shown is placed at the end of the single pedestrian and cycle path.

explain.short: Pedestrian above bicycle with a red bar: the shared path for pedestrians and cyclists ends.
explain.rule: Red bar = END of the shared path for pedestrians AND cyclists (both together).
explain.trap: 'fine del percorso unico pedonale e ciclabile' is right: the whole shared path ends.

sceneParams.caption: End of the shared path for pedestrians and bikes

q20404.en: The sign shown is placed at the end of the path reserved for mixed traffic of pedestrians and cyclists.

explain.short: The path shared by pedestrians and cyclists (mixed) ends here, as the red bar shows.
explain.rule: Red bar = END of the shared path for pedestrians AND cyclists (both together).
explain.trap: 'circolazione mista' (mixed traffic) is right: it is the shared path, and 'fine' says it ends.

sceneParams.caption: End of the mixed pedestrian and cycle path

q20405.en: The sign shown is placed at a path reserved for pedestrians and bicycles.

explain.short: The red bar means the path ENDS. The start of the path is the same sign without the bar.
explain.rule: Red bar = END of the shared path for pedestrians AND cyclists (both together).
explain.trap: The statement forgets the red bar: it is the END of the path, not the path itself.

sceneParams.caption: Red bar: the shared path ENDS here

q20406.en: The sign shown is placed at the end of the cycle path only.

explain.short: The sign shows a pedestrian too: the whole shared path ends, not only the cycle path.
explain.rule: Red bar = END of the shared path for pedestrians AND cyclists (both together).
explain.trap: 'della sola pista ciclabile' (of the cycle path only) is wrong: the pedestrian is also crossed out.

sceneParams.caption: Both end: pedestrians AND cyclists

q20407.en: The sign shown forbids bicycles pushed by hand to pass.

explain.short: An end sign forbids nothing: the shared pedestrian and cycle path simply ends.
explain.rule: Red bar = END of the shared path for pedestrians AND cyclists (both together).
explain.trap: 'vieta il transito' (forbids passage) is wrong: blue + red bar = end, not ban.

sceneParams.caption: No ban: the shared path ends

q20408.en: The sign shown is placed at the end of the pedestrian path only.

explain.short: The bicycle is also crossed out: the whole shared path ends, not only the pedestrian part.
explain.rule: Red bar = END of the shared path for pedestrians AND cyclists (both together).
explain.trap: 'del solo percorso pedonale' (of the pedestrian path only) is wrong: the bicycle is on the sign too.

sceneParams.caption: Both end: pedestrians AND cyclists

q20409.en: The sign shown does not allow vehicles to pass.

explain.short: The path is reserved for riding and pack animals, so no vehicle of any kind may use it.
explain.rule: Blue round sign with horse and rider = path ONLY for riding and pack animals. No vehicles at all.
explain.trap: 'non consente il transito ai veicoli' (no vehicles) is right: the path is only for animals.

sceneParams.caption: Only riding and pack animals: no vehicles

q20410.en: The sign shown does not allow bicycles to pass.

explain.short: Bicycles are vehicles too: they may not use a path reserved for animals.
explain.rule: Blue round sign with horse and rider = path ONLY for riding and pack animals. No vehicles at all.
explain.trap: 'biciclette' (bicycles) is right: even bicycles are vehicles and are excluded.

sceneParams.caption: Bicycles not allowed: animals only

q20411.en: The sign shown does not allow vehicles with an electric motor to pass.

explain.short: No vehicle may use the path, electric ones included. It is only for riding and pack animals.
explain.rule: Blue round sign with horse and rider = path ONLY for riding and pack animals. No vehicles at all.
explain.trap: 'motore elettrico' (electric motor) is right: electric or not, vehicles are excluded.

sceneParams.caption: No electric vehicles either: animals only

q20412.en: The sign shown is placed at the start of a path reserved for riding animals.

explain.short: The horse and rider mark the start of a path reserved for riding animals (animali da sella).
explain.rule: Blue round sign with horse and rider = path ONLY for riding and pack animals. No vehicles at all.
explain.trap: 'animali da sella' (riding animals, like horses with a rider) is right.

sceneParams.caption: Start of a path for riding animals

q20413.en: The sign shown is placed at the start of a path reserved for pack animals.

explain.short: The path is reserved for riding animals and also for pack animals (animali da soma, which carry loads).
explain.rule: Blue round sign with horse and rider = path ONLY for riding and pack animals. No vehicles at all.
explain.trap: 'animali da soma' (pack animals) is right: the path is for both riding and pack animals.

sceneParams.caption: Start of a path for pack animals too

q20414.en: The sign shown is placed near a riding school.

explain.short: It does not mark a place like a riding school: it marks a path reserved for riding and pack animals.
explain.rule: Blue round sign with horse and rider = path ONLY for riding and pack animals. No vehicles at all.
explain.trap: 'scuola di equitazione' (riding school) is wrong: the sign is an obligation for a path, not a place name.

sceneParams.caption: A path for animals, not a riding school

q20415.en: The sign shown is a danger sign.

explain.short: It is round and blue: an obligation sign. Danger signs are red triangles.
explain.rule: Blue round sign with horse and rider = path ONLY for riding and pack animals. No vehicles at all.
explain.trap: 'segnale di pericolo' (danger sign) is wrong: blue round = obligation, red triangle = danger.

sceneParams.caption: Blue round = obligation, not danger

q20416.en: The sign shown forbids pack and riding animals to pass.

explain.short: It is the opposite: the path is reserved FOR pack and riding animals.
explain.rule: Blue round sign with horse and rider = path ONLY for riding and pack animals. No vehicles at all.
explain.trap: 'vieta il passaggio' (forbids passage) is wrong: blue = reserved for them, not a ban.

sceneParams.caption: Reserved FOR animals, not against them

keywords.it: animali da soma e da sella

q20417.en: The sign shown warns of loose animals.

explain.short: Loose animals are warned by a red triangle. This blue sign marks a path for riding animals.
explain.rule: Blue round sign with horse and rider = path ONLY for riding and pack animals. No vehicles at all.
explain.trap: 'animali vaganti' (loose animals) is wrong: that is a danger sign, not this obligation sign.

sceneParams.caption: Not loose animals: a path for riders

q20418.en: The sign shown warns of the obligation to give way to animals crossing.

explain.short: The sign reserves a path for riding and pack animals. It says nothing about giving way.
explain.rule: Blue round sign with horse and rider = path ONLY for riding and pack animals. No vehicles at all.
explain.trap: 'dare precedenza' (give way) is wrong: the sign marks a reserved path, not a crossing.

sceneParams.caption: A reserved path, not a give-way rule

q20419.en: The sign shown is placed at the end of a path for pack animals.

explain.short: The red bar across the horse means the path for pack and riding animals ends here.
explain.rule: Red bar = END of the path reserved for riding and pack animals.
explain.trap: 'fine di un percorso per gli animali da soma' is right: the path was also for pack animals.

sceneParams.caption: End of the path for pack animals

q20420.en: The sign shown is placed at the end of a path for riding animals.

explain.short: The red bar means the path reserved for riding animals ends here.
explain.rule: Red bar = END of the path reserved for riding and pack animals.
explain.trap: 'fine di un percorso per gli animali da sella' is right: the horse and rider are crossed out.

sceneParams.caption: End of the path for riding animals

q20421.en: The sign shown is placed at the end of the path reserved for pack and riding animals.

explain.short: This is exactly the meaning: the path for pack and riding animals ends.
explain.rule: Red bar = END of the path reserved for riding and pack animals.
explain.trap: 'fine del percorso riservato agli animali da soma e da sella' is the full, exact meaning.

sceneParams.caption: End of path for pack and riding animals

keywords.it: animali da soma e da sella

q20422.en: The sign shown is placed near a racecourse.

explain.short: It marks the end of a path for riding and pack animals, not a racecourse (ippodromo).
explain.rule: Red bar = END of the path reserved for riding and pack animals.
explain.trap: 'ippodromo' (racecourse) is wrong: the sign is about a reserved path, not a place for races.

sceneParams.caption: End of an animal path, not a racecourse

q20423.en: The sign shown forbids animal-drawn vehicles to pass.

explain.short: An end sign forbids nothing: the path for riding and pack animals simply ends.
explain.rule: Red bar = END of the path reserved for riding and pack animals.
explain.trap: 'vieta il transito' (forbids passage) is wrong: blue + red bar = end, not ban.

sceneParams.caption: No ban: the animal path ends

q20424.en: The sign shown is placed at the end of a stretch of road closed to horses.

explain.short: The road was not closed to horses: it was a path reserved FOR them, and now it ends.
explain.rule: Red bar = END of the path reserved for riding and pack animals.
explain.trap: 'vietato ai cavalli' (closed to horses) is wrong: the path was reserved for horses, not closed.

sceneParams.caption: End of a path FOR horses, not against them

q20425.en: The sign shown is placed at the end of a path reserved only for racehorses.

explain.short: The path was for all riding and pack animals, not only for racehorses.
explain.rule: Red bar = END of the path reserved for riding and pack animals.
explain.trap: 'solo ai cavalli da corsa' (only racehorses) is wrong: it is for riding and pack animals in general.

sceneParams.caption: For all riding and pack animals, not racehorses
